enchantments.tooltip: Power Store: This item collects and stores magical energy. Any spellcaster can use this energy to partially power their spells. All spells cast while using this item receive an enhancement bonus of -10% to their spell point costs.
Insightful Resistance +1: Passive: +1 Insight bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Vitality +12: Passive: +12 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.
Poison Resistance +14: Passive: +14 Enhancement bonus to your Poison Resistance.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
